verdicts.evidence: tmjssz (2026-07-10 15:31) said the behaviour is intended: the revert button resets the flag and the sidebar badge shows the override count. The bot dropped the finding, and the Switch in FeatureFlagRow.tsx still always dispatches setOverride.
store/index.ts:67 and :95 still register and persist featureFlagOverridesSlice unconditionally, as they did at b3a1e7e. No human replied to this point.
At b3a1e7e the test used MARKER = 'local feature-flag overrides' (banner copy). Commit c7c3e4b74 replaced it with a dedicated, imported EDITOR_BUNDLE_SENTINEL, and the bot confirmed the fix.
The slice is still persisted unconditionally at store/index.ts:95 and there is no prod cleanup. The bot repeated this 'for the record' on 07-29 and no human responded.

The author kept the unconditional useAppSelector(selectOverrideCount) and, per the bot's re-review, added an inline comment calling it an intentional rules-of-hooks trade-off. The call now lives in useFeatureFlagsItem.tsx:10.
Commit c7c3e4b74 ('Document that useFeatureFlagEditorData reads raw (un-overridden) config') added the doc comment above useFeatureFlagEditorData.
At b3a1e7e the Check had only an aria-label. c7c3e4b74 and d70d9b835 ('expose the flag match indicator to AT') added role="img" to it (FeatureFlagRow.tsx), and the bot acknowledged the change.
c7c3e4b74 ('comment the layout spacer') added a comment above the w-12 span explaining that it reserves the width of the indicator and revert button.
c7c3e4b74 added the useChains.test.ts case 'handles an override key that is not a known feature (string cast)'. It now lives in useChainOverrides.test.ts:87 (CUSTOM_UNKNOWN_FLAG).
tmjssz replied 'Good idea! done -> 9accdf3b9', a commit that renamed features/feature-flags to features/feature-flag-overrides. The old folder name existed at b3a1e7e.
At b3a1e7e the rows were sorted with localeCompare inside useMemo. c7c3e4b74 hoisted SORTED_FEATURES to module scope (useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts).

The bot's concern was that screen-reader users never hear the match label. The author then added role="img" with aria-label on the Check icon (c7c3e4b74 / d70d9b835), and the later bot review confirmed that AT users no longer need hover.
